episodes.synopsis: Kei Matoba is a detective in the city of dreams, San-Teresa. He works with the Special Vice Squad, who deal with fantasy creatures from another world that have moved into our own.
episodes.title: COP SHOW, WITCH CRAFT

episodes.synopsis: The duo are hot on the tail of the man who killed Kei's partner. But his plans are more sinister than they might appear...
episodes.title: DRAGNET MIRAGE

episodes.synopsis: Kei and Tilarna are hot on the trail of the fairy thief, but Tilarna gets upset at the investigation's slow pace, and sets out on her own...
episodes.title: MIDNIGHT TRAIN

episodes.synopsis: Kei and Tilarna track down Zelada, the wizard with the fairy bomb. Can they stop him before he turns the whole city into his slaves?
episodes.title: IN THE AIR TONIGHT

episodes.synopsis: Kei and Tilarna chase the vampire who nearly killed Cecil. Their foe is isolated and in a strange world, but far smarter than she appears...
episodes.title: LONESOME VAMPIRE

episodes.synopsis: During a high-speed pursuit of a gang of adult magazine thieves, Tilarna wrecks Kei's beloved car. Can they capture the criminals, and will Kei ever forgive her?
episodes.title: NEED FOR SPEED

episodes.synopsis: Tilarna goes undercover at a high-class brothel to bust a major politican. But things get complicated when she becomes friends with one of the workers there...
episodes.title: GIRLS ON ICE

episodes.synopsis: What was supposed to be an ordinary raid on a small-time smuggling operation turns into something much worse, when a spell turns Tilarna into a cat!
episodes.title: SMELLS LIKE TOON SPIRIT

episodes.synopsis: Tilarna recovers her human body, but there's no time to celebrate when the leading candidate for mayor is shot.
episodes.title: A KING MAKER

episodes.synopsis: The duo investigate the case of the murdered mayoral candidate, but there's more to it than there first appeared to be…
episodes.title: COCK ROBIN, JOHN DOE

episodes.synopsis: Tilarna and Kei go deeper into the mystery of who's killing the mayoral candidates, but run into an unexpected figure.
episodes.title: TRANSITIONAL CRISES

episodes.synopsis: Zelada is revealed to be alive, and the person behind the murders. Tilarna and Kei face him in a final showdown.
episodes.title: TWO WORLDS, TWO JUSTICES
